en.attentionVisible: Also alert "needs you" while the page is open
en.attentionVisibleHint: On by default: alert even in the foreground when the model waits for approval / plan review / a question.
en.autoFocus: Click a toast to open that conversation
en.autoFocusHint: On by default: clicking a toast brings DSH forward and switches to the conversation the alert came from. When off, clicking a toast does nothing.
en.blurb: When the agent stops and needs your input (approval / plan review / question) or a reply finishes in the background, get a system notification, a sound, and a tab-title marker.
en.bridgeOff: Quick-decision buttons are unavailable right now (
en.bridgeOffDesktop: Quick-decision buttons are unavailable on Desktop: dsh-app:// pages cannot register a Service Worker, so approval toasts fall back to their plain, button-less form and the test button only sends a plain notification. This is a host limitation, not a broken setting.
en.bridgeOffTail: ); approval toasts fall back to their plain form.
en.currentQuiet: Stay quiet for the conversation on screen
en.currentQuietHint: On by default: a wait inside the conversation you are looking at keeps only the tab marker — no toast or sound landing on the approval card. Backgrounding the page puts the alert back.
en.doneVisible: Also alert "reply finished" while the page is open
en.doneVisibleHint: Off by default: "done" only alerts while the page is hidden or backgrounded, to avoid noise.
en.enableHint: Master switch: when off, no toasts, no sounds, and the tab title is never modified.
en.externalAttentionHint: Push approval / plan review / question alerts to the external endpoints too.
en.externalDoneHint: Push reply-finished alerts to the external endpoints too.
en.externalEmpty: No push targets yet — press "Add target" to create one.
en.externalEnableHint: Master switch: when off, nothing is sent to any external endpoint.
en.externalHint: Mirror alerts to a Discord webhook / Bark / Gotify / custom webhook so "come back" reaches you away from the machine. Same trigger rules as the local alerts (the visibility toggles above apply too).
en.externalNoTargets: Add at least one push target first.
en.externalOffHint: Turn on "Forward to external targets" first.
en.externalPrivacy: The alert title and body (including the session name and snippet) are sent as-is to the address you enter — only use endpoints you trust.
en.externalTargetsHint: Add as many as you like. Discord: the webhook URL; Bark: https://api.day.app/<device key> (self-hosted: http://<server>/<key>); Gotify: https://<server>/message?token=<app token>; custom: any endpoint accepting JSON (POST: source / event / title / body / sessionId / time).
en.externalTestHint: Send one test message to every push target above (the per-kind forward toggles do not apply to this button).
en.hostEnvDesktopForcedNote: (this page is not dsh-app://: a toast click will try to launch the dsh:// protocol and the browser may show an "open app?" prompt)
en.hostEnvHint: Auto-detect by default: a dsh-app:// page is the Desktop (DSH Desktop) shell, anything else is the Web. Override it if detection comes out wrong: on the Desktop a toast click raises the window through the dsh:// deep link and quick-decision buttons are unavailable; on the Web it is window.focus() plus the Service Worker bridge.
en.offHint: Reminders are off: enable them first, then test.
en.permHint: Notification permission is not granted yet — click once on the page and allow notifications so toasts can appear (sound is unaffected).
en.quickActionsHint: On by default: approval notifications carry Approve / Reject buttons, and one click settles the request exactly like the Allow once / Reject buttons on the approval card. Needs a Service Worker capable browser (http://127.0.0.1 or https); falls back to plain toasts where unavailable.
en.quickApprovalNote: "Approve" equals "Allow once" on the approval card — it allows that one call only.
en.soundCleared: Custom sound removed; this alert falls back to the built-in cue.
en.soundHint: Master cue switch; what it actually plays comes from "Alert sound" below.
en.soundNotAudio: That is not an audio file this browser can play.
en.soundOffHint: The Sound switch is off: turn it on to preview (with it off the alerts themselves stay silent too).
en.soundPreviewSystem: The system sound plays with a toast, not from the plugin — a test alert was sent instead; that sound is it.
en.soundQuota: Not enough browser storage for this file — remove the other kind's custom sound first, or pick a smaller file.
en.soundSourceHint: Each alert kind picks its own sound source; the two never affect each other. The default is the plugin's built-in cue.
en.soundSynthNote: The plugin's synthesized cue — "needs you" and "reply finished" use different patterns.
en.soundSystemNote: No plugin cue: the toast still appears, but the sound is left to the operating system, so its timbre follows your system notification settings. The Sound switch above still mutes it.
en.soundTooBig: File is too large; the limit is
en.subagentQuietHint: On by default: background sessions spawned by a subagent raise neither "needs you" nor "reply finished" alerts — they are steps of another conversation, already covered by that conversation's own alert. The subagent session you have open alerts as usual. Turn off to alert for every session.
en.testApprovalNoBridge: Plain test notification sent (quick-decision buttons need a Service Worker, which this environment lacks, so they cannot render).
en.testHint: Send one test alert with the current settings (not limited by the "while the page is open" toggles above).
en.testNeedsQuick: Turn on "Decide approvals from the toast" above to test the buttons.
en.toastHint: Native toasts via the browser (Windows notification center); requires notification permission.
